identification._calibration_note: calibrated on synthetic fixtures only (plus a partial check on 9 real papers; not on real data at scale: real-data calibration partial) (DARINT corpus_A sha256 06256b2f161c, corpus_C ce158e5576582; p3 diluted probe; 9 real full texts (verified dar9 corpus, shipped config): 8 domains; only the same-subject pair eyring2016+lehner2020 groups; sandve2013+wilson2017 do not (6 shared terms, cosine 0.38) and epi papers bracher2021 and gostic2020 do not - see _consolidate_note; evidence fix/epi/RECONCILE-7v8.md). Small corpora (N < assoc_salient_min_docs): whole-text cosine plus a non-ubiquitous shared-term minimum; a document matching no domain founds a derived domain at once (min_support 1). Larger corpora: shared-vocabulary view. Order effects are bounded, not eliminated: early over-splitting is possible, topic mixing is not intended.
identification._consolidate_note: calibrated on synthetic fixtures (demo9 + eco1, domains split by raising assoc_min_sim/sig_min_shared) and 9 real papers: same-subject domain pairs share 17-34 signature terms with cosine 0.62-0.94; different-subject pairs share <=6 (cos <=0.39) on the fixtures and <=8 (cos <=0.27) on the real papers; threshold 15 / 0.5 sits between the groups; the acceptance flow (demo9 + cross-subject doc X-1, after persist/restore) produced a pair at 12 shared / cos 0.62 (X-1 counted in two profiles after restore, a profile-reconstruction divergence from the live path), which 15 keeps apart. Real-data calibration partial: real epidemic-forecasting papers bracher2021 and gostic2020 (5 shared, cos 0.18) are LESS similar than bracher2021 and the ecological-forecasting paper petchey2015 (8, 0.27), so no similarity threshold merges the two epi papers without also merging epi with ecology forecasting; they are left apart.
